visualReview.notes: Inspected seven current portable views. The two-storey cream facade, arched center windows, curved pediment, roof balustrade, and stepped entrance read together. Elevated rear views show the open court between distinct roof volumes.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected seven current shared-material views including the dated geographic placement. The scored facade and its sandstone trim remain distinct from standing-seam roofs, dark glazing, and the entry base. The placement overlay shows the wings and open court.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all 23 current context, detail, and transition views. All four detail levels preserve the footprint, court, and principal wing and portico masses. Closer views restore the arched sash, cornice, and balustrade detail.

geographicReview.notes: Used the 42-corner outer ring and 15-corner inner ring of OpenStreetMap relation 12509358 and separate mapped portico and passage roofs. The dedicated unmasked view of the original 128 m field shows the stepped entrance at the lawn and the foundation seated against local grades. The terrain datum and threshold elevations are approximate.

fidelityReview.scope: Old Government House at the University of Auckland as represented by the 2008 exterior reference, including the lawn façade, attached wings, open inner court and mapped northeast portico. The neighboring university clock tower, gatekeeper cottage, lawns and interiors are outside this asset.
fidelityReview.notes: The 2008 facade uses the photographed window rhythm, scored cream timber, ochre accents, pale portico, and curved center ornament. Heights, secondary elevations, and unseen roof treatment are estimated. The neighboring Gothic tower and gatekeeper cottage are outside the model.

imageryReview.notes: Used the existing Qualla original by Richard001, matched to the pinned Commons SHA-1 and explicit PD-self dedication. The dated 2008 photograph informed the exterior. No photograph pixels are used in the runtime asset.

validation.sharedCaptureScope: dated house, open court, and northeast entrance on the mapped Auckland placement

limitations: The 42-corner outer outline, 15-corner open court, attached northeast portico and rear covered passage come from mapped building and roof records. The central roof, wing roof slopes and concealed rear details are visual estimates.

One inspected 2008 public-domain photograph establishes the cream and ochre lawn facade, three arched upper sashes, segmental pediment, roof balustrade, stepped entry, roof stacks and hipped wings. The neighboring Gothic clock tower belongs to a separate building.

Vertical dimensions, secondary window positions, roof geometry and local grade are approximate. The 128 m original terrain field was frozen before the floor and sections. Model represents a dated 2008 interpretation.
